control_rule.source: Existing9mm position sphere divided bysqrt(3), used only for conditional integration; never a new arrival condition.
control_rule.order: original sign reset; approaching-axis capture clear; pause every increment inside actual strict9mm sphere; otherwise pause capture axes only; oldnormcap; unchangedP and one oldmotion damping; oldslew andmixedgeometry.
control_rule.retention: Outside captured axes, already stored bias survives unless the inherited sign reset removes it. Inside the sphere no new integral is added. P and motion damping continue; no forced zero command.

limitations: These proposed actions are evaluated on old observations; their later trajectories and success are unknown.
The per-axis delay band is a control heuristic, not a physical stopping-distance bound or future geometry certificate.
Early removal of integral may slow overcoming static offsets. Existing successes and PLACE are changed and require controlled physical evaluation.
Preserved counter-motion bias can remain during a near-stationary hold; this rule is not a guarantee of remaining inside the arrival sphere.
